annotation.title_clean: Commission Directive 95/54/EC of 31 October 1995 adapting to technical progress Council Directive 72/245/EEC on the suppression of radio interference produced by spark-ignition engines fitted to motor vehicles and amending Directive 70/156/EEC
annotation.title_en: Commission Directive 95/54/EC of 31 October 1995 adapting to technical progress Council Directive 72/245/EEC on the suppression of radio interference produced by spark-ignition engines fitted to motor vehicles and amending Directive 70/156/EEC
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Communities L 266
annotation.summary_en: Commission Directive 95/54/EC amends Directive 72/245/EEC to make it the specific EU type-approval directive on electromagnetic compatibility of all motor vehicles and electrical/electronic sub-assemblies. It sets emission and immunity limits, test methods, approval marking, and transition dates. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Extends Directive 72/245/EEC to all vehicle categories as a specific EMC directive from 1 January 1996.
Sets broadband and narrowband emission limits and immunity test levels for vehicles and ESAs.
Requires EEC type-approval, conformity of production, and an 'e' approval mark on ESAs.
Ends EEC type-approval for non-compliant types from 1 January 1996; certificate of conformity rules from 1 October 2002.
Member States must transpose before 1 December 1995.
